statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
There is concern for underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study was ordered
The diagnosis codes submitted are I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5
The claim was denied based on reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
